clubs.name: Ombre Javis
clubs.tagline: A fashion house that dresses the shadow first.
clubs.description: Ombre Javis cuts silhouettes from light and shade: gradient silks, architectural shoulders, veils that change colour as you walk. Holders get a seat at the Salon Javis séance shows and first refusal on every look.

clubs.name: Deer Park
clubs.tagline: Men's elegance, from the estate to the street.
clubs.description: Deer Park makes the modern gentleman: soft-shouldered tailoring, waxed field coats, evening suits with a pocket for a train ticket. Shows walk the estate lawns at golden hour.

clubs.name: Ponte Reye
clubs.tagline: The Italian flagship store, Milano.
clubs.description: Ponte Reye is the Italian flagship: one bridge of a store over the canal in Via Reye, carrying every house on Phiegg alongside its own Milanese line. The agent Ponte Reye runs the floor.

clubs.name: Onyx Hitch Hikers Club
clubs.tagline: Thumb out, towel ready, ride the galaxy.
clubs.description: The Onyx Hitch Hikers Club is a pool of 10,000 utility PFTs for riders who cross the galaxy one lift at a time. Every PFT is a ride pass, a seat at the Waystation parties and a vote on where the club goes next.

clubs.name: Bold Pups
clubs.tagline: A pack of 10,000 pups with somewhere to be.
clubs.description: Bold Pups is a pool of 10,000 utility PFTs: each pup is a membership, a walk on the Orbit runway and a share of the pack fund. Pups swap, play fetch quests and throw the loudest pool parties on the moon.

clubs.name: Epic Pods AC
clubs.tagline: An athletic club built from escape pods.
clubs.description: Epic Pods AC turns old escape pods into gyms, tracks and ateliers. Its pool holds 10,000 utility PFTs: a locker, a lane on the zero-g track and a vote in the Belt League.

clubs.name: Calder Brothers Pictures
clubs.tagline: Four brothers, one backlot, a picture every Friday since 1941.
clubs.description: Calder Brothers Pictures is the golden-age studio of Phiegg: noirs, westerns, musicals and melodramas shot between the 1940s and the 1960s on one enormous backlot. Every PFT is a seat in the screening room and a vote on the next restoration.

clubs.name: The Venus Girls
clubs.tagline: One family, five sisters, every camera in the hills.
clubs.description: The Venus Girls is Phiegg’s reality drama: five sisters and their momager running a beauty empire, a fashion line and a feud a week, all on camera. Every PFT is a vote on what happens next episode.

clubs.name: Halo Models
clubs.tagline: The model house behind every big runway.
clubs.description: Halo Models casts the shows: every model on the Halo board walks for the houses of Phiegg, and every PFT is a seat at casting day.

clubs.name: Supernova Records
clubs.tagline: Super fashion music: the soundtrack of every runway.
clubs.description: Supernova Records signs the singers who score the shows: runway pop, couture house, velvet soul and starlight R&B. Every PFT is a backstage pass and a share of the streams.

clubs.name: Velvet Lip Co.
clubs.tagline: Beauty in sixty-four shades.
clubs.description: Velvet Lip Co. makes the lipsticks, glosses, blushes and scents the shows wear. Every product line is a drop of 64 shades, and every shade is a PFT you can swap for any other.

clubs.name: Wondrous Motor Couture
clubs.tagline: Flying cars cut like couture.
clubs.description: Wondrous Motor Couture builds flying cars the way a house builds gowns: a fitting for every driver, a lining to match the coat, a colour named after the evening it was first flown. Holders get a garage in Wondrous and a lane on the Saturday sky parade.

clubs.name: Skylane Social
clubs.tagline: The fashion club with a landing pad.
clubs.description: Skylane Social is the members club of Wondrous: a rooftop pool, a valet for flying cars and a dress code that changes every week. Members get a pad on the roof and a look for every lane.

clubs.name: Hover House
clubs.tagline: Streetwear for people who drive in the sky.
clubs.description: Hover House makes the jackets, boots and goggles of the skylane crews: reflective seams, wind-cut collars and pockets for a spare thruster key. Every drop is cut in the Hover Garages.

clubs.name: Verbum Atelier
clubs.tagline: A house that writes its clothes first.
clubs.description: Verbum Atelier begins every look as a sentence: a line of verse becomes a hem, a footnote becomes a pocket. Its flying cabs follow the sentences written across the sky. Holders get a library card, a cab account and a seat at the Reading Runway.

clubs.name: Inkwell Club
clubs.tagline: A fashion club for people who read the label.
clubs.description: Inkwell Club is a members library with a wardrobe: first editions on the shelves, first editions on the rails. Members borrow a look the way they borrow a book.

clubs.name: Syntax Society
clubs.tagline: Modern tailoring with perfect grammar.
clubs.description: Syntax Society is the tailoring club of Verbum: suits cut to the rules, then broken on purpose. Its fleet of Comma Cabs pauses at every corner of the city.

clubs.name: The Royal House of Naim
clubs.tagline: A palace, a forest, a horse show every summer.
clubs.description: The Royal House of Naim dresses the palace of Naim City: riding habits, ball gowns and the saffron silks of the summer show. Holders get a seat in the royal stand at the Naimian Horse Show and an invitation to the Midsummer Ball.

clubs.name: Lora Land Society
clubs.tagline: The land around the flagship, where every street is a fitting room.
clubs.description: Lora Land is the country around Lora's Spark: tutu terraces, a summer show on the lawn and robo vans that deliver a fitting to your door before the kettle boils. Holders get a window on Spark Square and a seat at the Summer Show.

clubs.name: Chatterbox Atelier
clubs.tagline: A valley where everything talks back.
clubs.description: Chatty Valley is where the agents live: cafes where the coffee asks how you slept, a market where the stalls haggle for you and an atelier that sews conversations into the lining. Holders get a voice of their own in the valley and a corner table at Babble Market.

clubs.name: Bozo Brothers Circus Couture
clubs.tagline: The circus that dresses the whole city.
clubs.description: Bozo City is one long fair: a big top on every corner, a sky wheel over the main square and the Bozo Brothers cutting ringmaster coats and acrobat silks for anyone brave enough to wear them. Holders ride free on every fun ride and get a seat by the ring.

clubs.name: Skim City Board Club
clubs.tagline: Boards, wakes and jetskis on every canal.
clubs.description: Skim City is built on canals: kids skim boards across the shallows, jetskis carry the post and the Board Club cuts wetsuits that look like evening wear. Holders get a slip at Wake Park and the first jetski of every drop.

clubs.name: Loon Lake Lodge
clubs.tagline: Moonlight, loons and saucers over the lake.
clubs.description: Loon City sits around a black lake where the loons call all night and, once a month, flying saucers come down to drink the moonlight. The Lodge dresses the city in quilted coats, lantern silks and boots for the pier. Holders get a cabin on the shore and a seat at Saucer Night.

clubs.name: Wand & Wonder Atelier
clubs.tagline: Every coat has a wand pocket.
clubs.description: Wand City is a city of wandwrights, star towers and mirror markets, where a good cape is cut to cast in and the saucers from Loon City come to be enchanted. Holders get a wand fitted at Wandwright Lane and a key to the Star Tower library.

clubs.name: Maison Once
clubs.tagline: Jewellery and watches, once in a lifetime.
clubs.description: Once City sells time and light: rings and necklaces on Carat Court, watches in the Clockwork Quarter and pearls in the passage between them. Maison Once makes every piece in an edition of one, and robo vans carry them in velvet boxes. Holders get a private viewing and a fitting for a watch.

clubs.name: Delphine Atelier
clubs.tagline: A couture house that cuts every look by hand.
clubs.description: Delphine Atelier: Hand-cut couture, fittings by appointment and one show a season. Holders get the front row at Delphine Pier and first refusal on every look.

clubs.name: Rosewood Mill
clubs.tagline: Street tailoring for the late shift.
clubs.description: Rosewood Mill: Utility cuts, reflective seams and drops that sell out by sunrise. Holders get the front row at Rosewood Quay and first refusal on every look.

clubs.name: Marigold Society
clubs.tagline: Heritage cloth, cut for now.
clubs.description: Marigold Society: Archive patterns from the mill, re-cut for the runway and the avatar. Holders get the front row at Marigold Promenade and first refusal on every look.

clubs.name: Garnet Society
clubs.tagline: Evening wear for long nights.
clubs.description: Garnet Society: Bias gowns, opera gloves and capes that move like smoke. Holders get the front row at Garnet Pier and first refusal on every look.

clubs.name: Calla Atelier
clubs.tagline: Resort looks for a season that never ends.
clubs.description: Calla Atelier: Linen, sun hats and swimwear for every coast in the world. Holders get the front row at Calla Galleria and first refusal on every look.

clubs.tagline: Soft tailoring and sharp collars.
clubs.description: Moss Row: Double-breasted suits, camel coats and silk ties in small runs. Holders get the front row at Moss Lido and first refusal on every look.

clubs.description: Fennel Atelier: Lip shades, scents and the gowns that frame them. Holders get the front row at Fennel Galleria and first refusal on every look.

worlds.name: Opalia
worlds.description: A tidal city of shell-white boulevards where every facade is a boutique.

worlds.name: Velour Veil
worlds.description: An AR layer over real streets: look up and the city is wearing Velour.

worlds.name: Lumen Mesa
worlds.description: A desert city run by 10,000 agent citizens who design, trade and gossip.

worlds.name: Swan Lake Pavilion
worlds.description: A single glass pavilion on a still lake. Performances every full moon.

worlds.name: Acro World
worlds.description: Aerial runways strung between floating towers; every look is judged mid-air.

worlds.name: Nebula
worlds.description: A drifting star-cloud city where fabrics are woven from light.

worlds.name: Naimia
worlds.description: A sunlit capital of ateliers and rooftop salons, home of Naim City.

cities.name: Palace Hill
cities.vibe: The palace, the stables and the royal stand

cities.name: Saffron Forest
cities.vibe: Where the white deer walks at dawn

cities.name: Show Grounds
cities.vibe: The arena of the Naimian Horse Show

worlds.name: Satin Reef
worlds.description: An underwater promenade of satin kelp and pearl-lit boutiques.

worlds.name: Carousel
worlds.description: A spinning fairground city where every ride ends on a runway.

worlds.name: Couture Coast
worlds.description: A seaside strip of flagship houses and tidal fitting rooms.

worlds.name: Velvet Dunes
worlds.description: Desert dunes that ripple like crushed velvet at dusk.

worlds.name: Glasshouse
worlds.description: A greenhouse metropolis where plants and garments grow together.

worlds.name: Silk Atlas
worlds.description: A map-shaped world; each continent is a different weave.

worlds.name: Pearl Ridge
worlds.description: Mountain terraces of nacre and cloud-level showrooms.

worlds.name: Runway Isle
worlds.description: One island, one endless runway, one ocean of audience.

worlds.name: Aurum
worlds.description: A gilded city where the streets are literally gold leaf.

worlds.name: Sequin Sea
worlds.description: A glittering ocean with floating sequin rafts for parties.

worlds.name: Chiffon Heights
worlds.description: Sheer skyscrapers that sway like chiffon in the wind.

worlds.name: Neon Atelier
worlds.description: A night city of glowing sewing rooms and AR street drops.

worlds.name: Tulle Valley
worlds.description: Soft valleys of layered tulle where ballet avatars rehearse.

worlds.name: Obsidian Bay
worlds.description: A black-glass harbor for monochrome purists.

worlds.name: Cashmere Peaks
worlds.description: Snow peaks with fireside lounges and knit chalets.

worlds.name: Gilded Grove
worlds.description: A forest of golden trees hung with jewelry.

worlds.name: Prism Port
worlds.description: A trading port where light splits into seasonal palettes.

worlds.name: Organza
worlds.description: A translucent city you can see straight through.

worlds.name: Brocade
worlds.description: An embroidered city stitched together block by block.

worlds.name: Ivory Tower
worlds.description: A vertical city of ivory salons and quiet libraries.

worlds.name: Orchid Rain
worlds.description: A monsoon city where umbrellas are the main accessory.

worlds.name: Solstice
worlds.description: A world with one endless golden hour.

worlds.name: Moonlace
worlds.description: A lunar city of silver lace domes.

worlds.name: Starling
worlds.description: A murmuration city that reshapes itself every night.

worlds.name: Crystalline
worlds.description: A frozen palace world carved from clear crystal.

worlds.name: Ember Coast
worlds.description: Volcanic beaches and molten-orange evening wear.

worlds.name: Halo
worlds.description: A ring world orbiting a runway sun.

worlds.name: Mosaic
worlds.description: A patchwork city where every tile is a creator’s shop.

worlds.name: Plume
worlds.description: A feathered sky city for statement headwear.

worlds.name: Kaleido
worlds.description: A shifting-pattern city that never looks the same twice.

worlds.name: Rosegold
